description: NGINX reverse proxy — connections, traffic, latency, and logs

panels.description: * Filtered noisy 404s like /favicon, browser icon probes, and missing media covers.
panels.title: HTTP Status Distribution

panels.description: * Filters long-lived socket/realtime connections, Grafana session pings, and client-canceled 499s.
panels.title: Avg Request Time by Service

targets.expr: avg by (service) (avg_over_time({job="nginx-access", service=~"$service"} !~ "socket.io|/jellyfin/socket|/api/live/ws|/signalr/messages|/api/login/ping" | pattern `<client> <host> - <user> [<time>] "<method> <path> <protocol>" <status> <bytes> <request_length> <request_time> <upstream_time> <cache> "<referrer>" "<agent>"` | status!="499" | unwrap request_time | __error__="" [1m])) * 1000

panels.description: * Filters long-lived socket/realtime connections, Grafana session pings, and client-canceled 499s.
panels.title: Avg Upstream Response Time by Service

targets.expr: avg by (service) (avg_over_time({job="nginx-access", service=~"$service"} !~ "socket.io|/jellyfin/socket|/api/live/ws|/signalr/messages|/api/login/ping" | pattern `<client> <host> - <user> [<time>] "<method> <path> <protocol>" <status> <bytes> <request_length> <request_time> <upstream_time> <cache> "<referrer>" "<agent>"` | status!="499" | unwrap upstream_time | __error__="" [1m])) * 1000

panels.title: Cache MISS Count
panels.description: Requests proxied to backend without cache hit. All authenticated requests (Authorization header) are BYPASS — HITs only occur for unauthenticated static assets.

panels.title: Cache HIT Count
panels.description: Requests served from nginx cache for unauthenticated cacheable assets.

targets.expr: {job="nginx-error", service=~"$service"} | regexp `^(?P<nginx_time>\d{4}/\d{2}/\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}) \[(?P<level>[^\]]+)\] (?P<worker>[^:]+): (?P<message>.*?), client: (?P<client>[^,]+), server: (?P<server>[^,]*), request: "(?P<method>[A-Z]+) (?P<path>[^ ]+) (?P<protocol>[^"]+)"(?:, upstream: "(?P<upstream>[^"]+)")?, host: "(?P<host>[^"]+)"(?:, referrer: "(?P<referrer>[^"]+)")?`
